summary: The prepared main checkout still directly registered graph-owned custom-all-reduce inputs during ROCm DSA decode with DP attention. Added a narrow policy that selects the stable pre-registered copy-in path only for DSA decode plus DP attention (and preserves the existing memory-saver behavior), forwarding it to both AITER and SGLang custom-all-reduce implementations. This matches open upstream PR #36088; linked PR #36079 instead disables only DSA dense dual graphs and does not address general DP-lane graph skew.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: all 7 initial policy/dispatch cases failed because the checkout had no DSA+DP capture policy. Raw output: reports/j-bbbcc73e6807/failing-before-policy.txt

Passing-after regression and independent boundaries: 9 cases cover DSA with and without DP attention, non-DSA DP attention, memory saver, registered/copy-in capture selection, deterministic SGLang dispatch, normal SGLang dispatch, and AITER dispatch. Raw output: reports/j-bbbcc73e6807/passing-after-policy.txt

On the assigned MI355X gfx950, four separately captured graphs replayed in reverse order through one stable BF16 staging address; observed FP32 sums [8192, 4096, 2048, 1024] exactly matched the independent expected values. Raw output: reports/j-bbbcc73e6807/gpu-stable-copy-graph.txt
Repository formatting, Ruff lint/format, AST, codespell, test registry, and other configured checks passed. Raw output: reports/j-bbbcc73e6807/pre-commit.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: Single assigned AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, executed the stable copy-in CUDA-graph numerical check. This is not a multi-rank custom-all-reduce reproduction.

remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned, so the reported eight-GPU TP8/DP4 skewed collective could not be reproduced or validated end to end.
The amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 weights were not available, so model logits, token generation, semantic accuracy, and throughput were not tested.

The GPU fixture validates stable-address copy-in across separately captured graphs on one device; it does not validate peer IPC registration, AITER/SGLang multi-rank custom-all-reduce kernels, or distributed replay skew.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
